description: Decode one EVM calldata hex string. POST JSON data, optional abi, decimals (0-36) and knownSpenders. Matches bundled ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, ERC-2612, Permit2, Multicall3 and common router selectors, or a caller-supplied ABI. Returns the function, arguments, human amounts when decimals are supplied, and flags for unlimited approval, setApprovalForAll, and a permit spender absent from knownSpenders. No RPC and no selector database. Not a clearance. USDC on Base only. Bad input is not charged. Price $0.01 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

decimals.description: Integer 0-36 from the caller. Human amounts use it. Omit to leave amounts raw.

knownSpenders.description: Addresses already named as permit spenders, at most 16
